repair.qualbinding.20261111.v1.mandatory3.claim.arxiv.2608.10677.limitation

  • This is a source-specific, first-party description; this repair does not independently reproduce experiments or audit operational execution and customer outcomes.
  • The benchmark has 100 selected tasks, twelve domain labels and 98 byte-distinct images. Professionals select/create charts, write objective questions, walkthroughs and ranges; three additional experts verify each task and at least one frontier failure is required for retention.
  • Twenty no-tools trials per task yield 2,000 scored responses per configuration, not 2,000 independently sampled tasks. Gemini 3.5 Flash grades equivalence to expert answers/ranges without seeing the chart; multipart answers are all-or-nothing and its own leaderboard entry is self-judging.
  • Table 3 freezes the July 2026 snapshot, reporting mean pass@1 and 95% confidence intervals. Display ranks and overlapping intervals do not establish statistically distinct capability tiers.
  • Eighty-one charts are online-sourced and nineteen are author-created. Provenance is reported; this repair does not independently establish redistribution rights for each image.
  • Failure explanations derive from qualitative trajectory review. This author did not audit judge validity, CI coverage or task corpus, and does not interpret the explanations as a controlled perception-versus-reasoning causal ablation.
